mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (title, content, writer, writed_at, product_id, file_name, file_type, file_data) VALUES (#{review.title}, #{review.content}, #{review.writer}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{review.productId}, #{review.fileName}, #{review.fileType}, #{review.fileData})
mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS review_id_id, title, content, writer, writed_at AS write_at, product_id, file_name, file_type, file_data FROM review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}

SELECT review_id, title, writer, writed_at, product_id ,file_name FROM review
ORDER BY review_id DESC LIMIT #{pager.rowsPerPage} OFFSET #{pager.startRowIndex}
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET title = #{review.title}, content = #{review.content}, file_name = #{review.fileName}, file_type = #{review.fileType}, file_data = #{review.fileData} WHERE review_id = #{review.reviewId}
